repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Final head for L1 (p1) · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T07:17Z
Head-sha: `1cb2c044f055146ef94b7dea356a940dfa66738a`

- Reproduced on `origin/main` 93bd4595, in the browser at the preview drawer's default 460 px width (the CRM example with a widened line item) and then in jsdom. Stock CRM line items do not reproduce.
- Root cause: `RelatedList`'s body-table layout effect lists its own output, `bodyTableColumnCap`, in its deps.
  - Each cap change re-reads at once. But `data-table` adopts a new `columns` prop one render later (it copies the prop into state in an effect), so that read measures the table drawn for the previous cap.
  - In the drawer's 326 px details column the cap flipped 1 → 2 → 1 on every commit until React #185. On the full page every column fits, so the cap never moves.
- Fix: one guard at the top of the body-table read in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`. The read refuses a table that still draws an earlier hand-over, and the existing cells MutationObserver re-reads when the table redraws. `recordDrawerStack.tsx` and `data-table.tsx` are untouched.
- Pins, in the existing harness `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`: a 326 px body table with the real `data-table`.
  - Red on unfixed main: the boundary message renders, and a probe saw 54 cap reads flipping between 1 and 2.
  - Green after.
  - The full-page control (1052 px) passes both ways.
  - Ablating the guard turns the drawer pin red (1 of 34); the guard was then restored.
- Browser, after the fix: every drawer width from 380 to 800 draws with no console error, and the full page draws all 6 columns.
- Readings, from the dev: plugin-detail 3943 tests passed; type-check exit 0; 38 gate families all exit 0; overlap-check clean against main, #37220 and #37215 (all three touch `RelatedList.tsx` and merge cleanly).
- Check-runs at this head: 42 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or running; `mergeable_state` clean.
- Size: +159/-1 in 3 files. Not governed. No spec change, so no L2 is owed.
- Handed to the seat session for L1. This zone does not ready or queue the PR before an ACCEPT on this head.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ ## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `1cb2c044f055146ef94b7dea356a940dfa66738a` · 2026-11-25T07:40Z - Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37244`, CLEAN, 13 items): - The PR is open, a draft, and based on `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #37212` (p1, open), and no closing keyword binds any other card. - It has 5 commits and touches 3 files, +159/-1. One `patch` changeset covers `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. - There is no `content/docs/releases/` path and no `+0/-0` file. - `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are both correct, since the change is UI-internal and touches no metadata or public surface. - i18n is untouched. - Check-runs at `1cb2c044f0`: 55 total, 42 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. - `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (aggregate plus shards 1–13), `Plan Test UI shards` and `Build & E2E UI` are all `success`. - These figures match the zone note 2026-11-25T07:18:22Z. `mergeable_state` is clean. - K = 15 (merge-base `93bd45957b`). `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `d7f299c0b1` is clean, and main has not touched `RelatedList.tsx` since the merge-base. - Mechanism, re-derived from the code: - The layout effect lists `bodyTableColumnCap` in its deps, so each `setBodyTableColumnCap` re-runs it synchronously in the same commit chain. - `data-table` re-seeds `columns` from the prop in a `useEffect` (`data-table.tsx:2337`), so the re-run's `read()` measures the table drawn for the previous cap. - The actions cell's measured width depends on how many columns are drawn, because a table narrower than its box stretches the actions cell. So the read of a stale table yields the other cap, and the cycle repeats until #185. - The zone's root-cause statement holds. - Is the guard a root-cause fix or a mask? - It removes the inconsistent input: every cap is now judged only against a table that draws exactly that cap's hand-over. - Once only settled draws are read, the loop is monotone. Drawing fewer columns can only widen the stretched actions cell, so it shrinks the available width and the cap cannot climb back. Drawing more columns can only narrow that cell, so the cap cannot fall back. - A settled-only read also runs from the `MutationObserver` (a microtask), not inside the commit, so it cannot re-enter #185 even in principle. - Verdict: a real fix for the stale read, not a mask. The underlying one-render lag in `data-table` is left in place and disclosed, which is right for a p1. - Does the pin reproduce the flip? - I re-ran it in a throwaway worktree at this head: `Tests 34 passed (34)`. - With the guard line replaced by a no-op, the 326 px drawer case goes red with the error boundary's text (`expected

to be null`, `failed to render` in the DOM). The 1052 px control stays green: `1 failed | 1 passed | 32 skipped`. - The pin uses the real `data-table`, so the one-render lag is the real one, not a stub. - Does a plain resize freeze a stale cap? No. I checked this with an L1 probe (`pr-37244/RelatedList.l1probe-37244.test.tsx`, PROBE2) at this head: - The table settled at 326 px with `omitted=3`. - Widened to 800 px, it drew all 4 columns with `omitted=null`, and 1052 px gave the same. - Narrowed back to 326 px, it settled at `omitted=2`. - A settled table has `drawn.length === handed`, so the guard lets every resize read through. A resize that lands mid-hand-over is picked up by the adoption's own mutation read. - M1 (must-fix) — the premise that this is the reported bug is unverified, and the PR closes the p1 card with `Fixes`. - The card reports #185 on cloud "平台 18.6.0" with stock hotcrm 6.6.0 line items. - `@object-ui/plugin-detail@18.6.0` and `@objectstack/console@18.6.0` both resolve to `958ee03594`. That `RelatedList.tsx` has no `bodyTableColumnCap` and no `bodyTableColumnsThatFit` (`grep -c` gives 0). The cap arrived with `d19d87529d` (#35824) 2026-11-20T10:28:56Z, which is not an ancestor of `958ee03594`. Its only body-table effect at 18.6.0 has deps `[bodyTableDrawn, isMobile]` and cannot self-loop. - So, if the tenant runs 18.6.0, its #185 has a different mechanism, and this PR does not touch it. - The dev's own repro on main also needed a locally widened line item ("Stock CRM line items do not reproduce"). The PR body discloses "not measured" but still closes the card. - Required: name the console build the tenant runs and show it contains `d19d87529d`, or reproduce the reported failure at `958ee03594` and say which mechanism it is. - If neither can be done, switch to `Part of #37212`, keep the card open, and write the closing arrangement as a comment with no verb next to the number. - S1 (should-fix) — the guard also matches a table that drew a shorter leading run by its own choice. The read then stops for good, freezing the cap and the overflow cue, which main does not do. - `data-table`'s header right-click menu offers "Hide column" on any table (`onContextMenu` at `data-table.tsx:4884`, then `hideColumn` and `setColumns(prev.filter…)`), body tables included. - Hiding the trailing drawn column leaves `drawn` a strict prefix of `keys` with `drawn.length !== handed`, so every later `read()` returns early. That freezes both `setBodyTableColumnCap` and `setBodyTableOverflows`. - L1 probe (PROBE): render at 1052 px, hide `total`, narrow to 326 px, then trigger a read. - At head: `{"keys":["product","tier","quantity"],"omitted":null,"overflow":"false"}`. Three columns (372 px plus 66) in a 326 px box, cut off, with no overflow cue and no frozen first column. - Guard ablated (main's read): `{"keys":["product","tier"],"omitted":"2","overflow":"true"}`. - The Acceptance note "Bound" discloses only the cap. It omits the overflow cue, and that this is a regression from main. - Its "data-table also re-seeds its columns on the list's next re-render" holds only when that re-render hands a new `columns` array. With cap `null` the list hands `tableColumns` by reference, and a resize does not re-render the list. In the probe nothing re-seeded. - Fix: tell the lag apart from a table's own choice. For example, keep the previous hand-over's length in a ref, skip only while `drawn.length` equals it and differs from `handed`, and update it once the table draws `handed`. - Pin the hide-then-narrow case with an ablation reading. Then narrow the body's "so the guard recognises exactly that lag" and the changeset's "The read now waits until the table draws the columns it was handed" to whatever the new guard does. - Changeset, read sentence by sentence: - "could fail with … React error #185, while the record's full page drew the same table" is true on main. The release it implies is the subject of M1. - "re-read measured the table still drawn for the previous choice, because the table adopts a new set of columns a render later" is true. - "one column, then two, then one again" is true and matches the ablated pin. - "The read now waits until the table draws the columns it was handed" is true only while the table eventually draws them (S1). - "A table wide enough for every column … is unchanged" is true: the control is green both ways and the guard passes at `drawn.length === keys.length`. - 维护者速读: - 「用户能看到什么变化」 and 「为什么做」 are accurate as to main. 「这是产品负责人报告的高优先级缺陷」 matches the card (Irene, p1), but whether merging fixes her tenant is M1. - 「出错会怎样 … 最坏是窄栏里显示的列数不对」 understates S1. The worst case is also a cut-off column with no overflow cue after a 「隐藏列」, so re-read the line after S1. - N1 — The 326 px settle is path-dependent: - On open it settles at cap 1 (`omitted=3`), and after a widen-then-narrow at cap 2 (`omitted=2`). PROBE2 shows both. - The reason is that `besideColumns` counts the actions cell's stretched width (`66 + stretch share`) as space the row actions need. - This was already in the read before this PR and is not caused by the guard. Still, the pin's "the cap settles on the leading columns that fit" overstates it at 326 px, where two columns fit (104 + 156 + 66 = 326). - It could be a follow-up note rather than part of this PR. - Test evidence: L1 probe file and logs are under `scratchpad/pr-37244/`: `test-head.log`, `test-ablate.log`, `probe-head.log`, `probe-ablate.log` and `probe2-head.log`. - Overlap with #37220 (head `8c0243b10f`): both landing orders merge cleanly and keep both changes. Details are in `pr-37220/l1-delta.md`.
